newsitem.title: USA: Neurogen, Tularik in collaboration deal.
newsitem.headline: Neurogen, Tularik in collaboration deal.

text.p: Neurogen Corp said Tuesday it entered a drug discovery collaboration agreement with Tularik Inc.
Neurogen said under the agreement, it will gain access to selected Tularik screening methodologies and Tularik will gain access to a portion of Neurogen's chemistry library.
Both companies are eligible to receive payments and royalties based on the development and commercialization of products discovered under the collaboration.
Neurogen develops drugs for anxiety, obesity, schizophrenia and other disorders. Tularik is focused on development of therapeutic agents that regulate gene expression.
